subject: McGlynn Playground Redesign
overview: Recreation therapist and playground inspector Chenine Peloquin discussed the inclusive redesign of the McGlynn School playground and playground safety principles across Medford. The conversation detailed student-led design input, site engineering challenges, funding coordination, and park stewardship.

items.title: Introduction and Community Background
items.summary: Chenine Peloquin introduced herself as a Medford resident and discussed local restaurants accommodating dietary restrictions.

items.title: Professional Background in Recreation and Play
items.summary: Peloquin explained her background as a recreation therapist, playground safety inspector, and playworker focused on inclusive and self-directed play.

items.title: McGlynn Playground Redesign Process
items.summary: Peloquin detailed the community and student consultation process behind redesigning the McGlynn School playground into an accessible, shaded play space.

items.title: Playground Safety Standards and Risk
items.summary: Peloquin discussed age-graded design guidelines, common misperceptions regarding safety surfacing, state surfacing rules, and the developmental benefits of risk-taking in play.

items.title: Carr Park Construction and Community Stewardship
items.summary: Peloquin urged the public to stay out of active construction areas at Carr Park to prevent damage and discussed building youth ownership of public recreational spaces.

items.title: McGlynn Site Challenges, Funding, and District Equity
items.summary: Peloquin detailed site drainage work, the blending of ARPA, CPA, and CDBG funding for the McGlynn project, and safety repairs completed at other school playgrounds.
